sn17.4:1.3: seyyathāpi bhikkhave dīghalomikā eḷakā kaṇṭakagahanaṃ paviseyya
sn17.4:1.4: sā tatra tatra sajjeyya tatra tatra gaṇheyya 6 tatra tatra bajjheyya tatra tatra anayabyasanaṃ āpajjeyya
sn17.4:1.5: evameva kho bhikkhave idhekacco bhikkhu lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūto pariyādinna citto pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisati
sn17.4:1.6: so tatra tatra sajjati tatra tatra gayhati tatra tatra bajjhati tatra tatra anayabyasanaṃ āpajjati.
